Software Development Interns - Waterloo University

Remote - Winter Session

About Brave

Brave is on a mission to protect the human right to privacy online. We’ve built a free web browser that blocks creepy ads and trackers by default, a private search engine with a truly independent index, private AI assistant, latest privacy and security features, and a private ad network (opt-in!) that directly rewards you for your attention. Already over 120 million people regularly use Brave for a faster, more private web. Millions more switch every month.

The internet is a sea of ads, hackers, and echo chambers. Big Tech makes huge profits off our data, and tells us what’s true and what’s not. Brave is fighting back. Join us!

Brave is hiring 2 Software Engineer interns this fall from Waterloo University to assist adding AI, security and privacy features to our products. 

Software Developer Co-op - Internship Role One

Contribute to the design, development, and maintenance of data-intensive systems and AI-powered services. 

Key responsibilities include:

  • Build and maintain ETL pipelines for ingesting, transforming, and loading structured and unstructured data across internal systems
  • Develop backend services and tooling in Python and TypeScript to support data processing workflows and API integrations
  • Integrate and optimize LLM inference pipelines, including prompt engineering, model serving, and evaluation of large language model outputs
  • Deploy and manage containerized workloads on Kubernetes, including writing manifests, configuring autoscaling, and troubleshooting cluster issues
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to improve data quality, pipeline reliability, and system observability

Software Developer (Privacy) Co-op - Internship Role 2

Contribute to the design, development, and shipping of privacy and security features in the Brave browser (based on Chromium).

Key responsibilities include:

  • Prototype, implement, and ship privacy-enhancing features end-to-end in C++ or Rust for the Brave browser
  • Build browser-native privacy protections privacy-enhancing permissions and anti-fingerprinting defenses
  • Navigate and contribute to an extremely large, complex codebase, applying knowledge of the Web security model and Chromium's architecture
  • Work with Web technologies (HTML, CSS, JavaScript) to develop and validate browser features
  • Collaborate async with a geographically-distributed, open source team using Git and GitHub

Working at Brave - What we offer

  • Ability to work remotely at an exciting and well-funded international startup headquartered in San Francisco
  • Cutting-edge technology, allowing you to work with state-of-the-art tools and software solutions
  • Competitive compensation of $6000.00 per month for 4 months.
  • Great international exposure and team atmosphere

If you are currently a student at Waterloo University, we would love to hear from you.  We offer flexible schedules to accommodate your studies.

About Paxos

Today’s financial infrastructure is archaic, expensive, inefficient and risky — supporting a system that leaves out more people than it lets in. So we’re rebuilding it.

We’re on a mission to open the world’s financial system to everyone by enabling the instant movement of any asset, any time, in a trustworthy way. For over a decade, we’ve built blockchain infrastructure that tokenizes, custodies, trades and settles assets for the world's leading financial institutions, like PayPal, Venmo, Mastercard, Interactive Brokers and Charles Schwab.

About the team

The Identity & Regulatory Platform team builds the trust layer behind every Paxos product. Before a financial institution or its end users can move a single asset on Paxos, they come through us: identity verification, KYC/KYB, sanctions and risk screening, and the onboarding and activation experience in the Paxos Dashboard and Identity APIs. We also build the AI-enabled tools Compliance uses to review applications and manage risk at scale. Our goal is to turn complex regulatory requirements into fast, automated product flows, so that compliance speeds growth up instead of slowing it down.

About the role

As a Senior Software Engineer on the team, you'll build the AI-enabled trust layer that lets the world's largest financial institutions adopt blockchain safely. You'll own the customer journey from first contact through onboarding to activation. That means designing the systems that verify and onboard customers, using AI to automate compliance review, and measuring and improving every step of the funnel. You'll work directly with Product, Compliance and identity vendors, and your work will shape both how fast customers go live and how well Paxos meets its regulatory obligations.

What you’ll do

  • Own the customer journey from lead to onboarding to activation, across the Paxos Dashboard and Identity APIs

  • Instrument the onboarding funnel, find drop-off and friction, and run experiments that cut time-to-activation

  • Design, build and operate backend services for KYC/KYB, identity verification, screening and identity lifecycle

  • Use AI to automate compliance work such as document review, case triage and risk assessment, replacing manual ops

  • Own integrations with third-party identity and screening vendors, including async workflows and webhooks

  • Build data-privacy capabilities (GDPR erasure, PII handling) into the platform from the start

  • Write design docs, lead technical decisions, mentor teammates and take part in on-call

About you

  • 5+ years building production backend systems, with 1+ year at senior level

  • Strong in Go, Java or Python (Go strongly preferred)

  • Experience designing APIs and data models for sensitive or regulated data

  • You think about outcomes such as conversion, activation and time-to-value, not only shipping features

  • Comfortable turning ambiguous requirements from non-engineering stakeholders into clear technical plans

  • Bonus: identity, KYC/AML or onboarding systems; growth engineering or experimentation; building LLM features into production; Persona or similar vendors

  • You use AI tools daily to work faster and better

Important Notice for Paxos Applicants
Fraudulent accounts sometimes pose as Paxos recruiters on LinkedIn and other platforms, and fake websites sometimes impersonate our careers site. These scammers attempt to deceive applicants into paying for job opportunities or providing personal financial information.

To verify a legitimate Paxos opportunity:

  • Our only official careers site is paxos.com/careers

  • We only use @paxos.com email addresses

  • We never ask for payment or financial details to apply, interview, or work here

  • For technical roles, we do not perform a coding interview without prior screening by our engineering team

Thanks for your interest in Paxos!

Who we are 

We simplify wealth creation. Founded in 2014 in Vienna, Austria by Eric Demuth, Paul Klanschek and Christian Trummer, we’re here to help people trust themselves enough to build their financial freedom — for now and the future. Our user-friendly, trade-everything platform empowers both first-time investors and seasoned experts to invest in the cryptocurrencies, crypto indices, stocks*, precious metals and commodities* they want — with any sized budget, 24/7. Our global team works across different cultures and time zones, bringing our products to more than 7 million customers, making us one of Europe’s safest and most secure platforms that powers modern investing.

Headquartered in Austria but operating across Europe, our products are built by fast-moving, talented, “roll-up-your-sleeves-and-make-it-happen” kind of people. It’s these diverse perspectives and innovative minds operating as ONE TEAM that keep Bitpanda at the cutting edge of our industry. So if you’re someone who thinks big, moves fast and wants to make an impact right from day one, then get ready to join our industry-changing team. Let’s go!

Your mission

Bitpanda serves millions of investors across Europe, and we're bringing regulated finance onchain with Vision Chain, our own OP Stack L2 blockchain. We are building the premier ecosystem for European financial institutions to issue and distribute euro-denominated tokenized assets. We're hiring a Lead Technical Product Manager to own Vision Chain as a product: the foundation that Bitpanda's onchain products run on.

You'll own how the chain works and evolves, covering topics spanning proof systems, core protocol modifications, selecting the infrastructure providers, and more. You'll design and implement compliance, identity and privacy solutions into and on the chain, to satisfy the requirements of both financial institutions and developers. You'll work on this in collaboration with both internal and external product and engineering teams, as well as Bitpanda's Compliance, Legal and Data Protection teams, as an individual contributor reporting to the Head of Web3 Product within a small, senior team.

What you’ll do 

  • Own Vision Chain at the infrastructure level, managing configuration choices (fee mechanism, block building logic, etc.), and modifications to the OP Stack, in collaboration with the OP Labs team.
  • Manage infrastructure partnerships, owning the technical relationship with providers (RPC nodes, indexing, oracles, etc.). 
  • Collaborate with Compliance and Legal to implement regulatorily-compliant onchain transaction screening, identity, and privacy solutions.
  • Run reliability, incidents and cost, and own developer documentation and partner technical onboarding until a developer relations lead joins.
  • Coordinate with the other Vision Web3 product leads to ensure the chain’s technical roadmap supports the product roadmap being built on top of it.

Who you are 

  • 6+ years of product or engineering experience, with 3+ years focused on blockchain infrastructure (e.g., L1/L2, rollup-as-a-service, node infrastructure provider, account abstraction, or an exchange protocol team).
  • Deep understanding of EVM rollup mechanics, including sequencing, fees, proofs, withdrawals, bridges, upgrade keys, and account abstraction.
  • Proven ability to translate complex business and regulatory needs into precise technical requirements and drive them to delivery through engineering teams and external partners without direct management.
  • Experience partnering with Compliance, Legal, and Data Protection teams, possessing working knowledge of the EU crypto regulatory landscape (MiCA, DORA, AML/CFT, sanctions screening).
  • Exceptional written and spoken English communication skills for internal teams, leadership, and external partners.

** This position is available in all of our Hubs.

What’s in it for you

  • Flexibility to work where you thrive – Enjoy the freedom of our Hybrid working model, combining onsite collaboration and remote work, with an additional 25 days per year to work from a city or country of your choice.
  • Reward for your impact – Receive a competitive total compensation package aligned with Bitpanda’s pay-for-impact policy, including participation in our stock option plan.
  • Support for your mental wellbeing – Access confidential coaching, counselling, and mental health resources whenever you need them through OpenUP.
  • Time to recharge – On top of your standard annual leave, prioritise your wellbeing in 2027 with 3 additional days of paid time off to rest, reset, and recharge, available once you’ve been with us for 6 months.
  • Continuous learning and growth – Grow your skills and stay ahead in your career with unlimited access to Udemy’s library of online courses at your own pace.
  • Exclusive perks and rewards – Enjoy discounts, rewards, and perks from partners worldwide across lifestyle, wellness, tech, and travel.
  • Support during life milestones – Take advantage of up to 8 additional weeks of gender-neutral new parent leave to welcome and bond with your new addition to the family.
  • Fuel and focus on-site – Pandas in Vienna, Bucharest, Barcelona, and Berlin can enjoy free onsite dining, with freshly prepared lunches and snacks to keep you fueled and focused all day long.
  • Recognition for your contributions – Celebrate milestones and achievements with recognition and rewards for your Tenure at Bitpanda.
  • Show your Bitpanda pride – Access exclusive Bitpanda-branded merchandise and gear to represent.
  • Connect and celebrate with your team – Join unforgettable company events, from our Winter Party in Vienna to gatherings worldwide, fostering fun, connection, and celebration

       .…and even more location-specific benefits designed to make life at Bitpanda even more rewarding wherever you are.

Above all, you will have the opportunity to learn and grow as part of Bitpanda’s incredible journey towards being Europe’s future #1 investment platform.

Bitpanda is committed to fostering a fair and equal environment based on trust and mutual respect. We believe that a diverse and inclusive workplace is paramount to our success and we are committed to building a team that represents a wide variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills.

GoMining is a Bitcoin cloud-mining platform that has grown into a full crypto ecosystem: Digital Miners, the GOMINING token, GoMining Card, Wallet, Simple Earn, the VIP programme and Miner Wars. We’re growing fast and plan to multiply sales next year. A large part of that growth will come from partners who already have big audiences.

This role brings those partners in across MENA and Latin America. We’re hiring one BDM per region, and this position covers the MENA and LatAm markets. You’ll find and sign affiliates and partners with large networks in MENA and LatAm: crypto exchanges and media, iGaming operators and affiliate networks, brokers, fintech players, streamers and influencer agencies. Our offer to them is one of the strongest on the market: a high commission on every sale their audience makes, plus a lifetime revenue share. Your job is to put that offer in front of the right people and close the deal.

This is not a desk job and not mass cold outreach. You’ll spend much of your time in the field, at conferences, expos and meetings across MENA and LatAm, holding live negotiations every day. You’ll be one of the first members of a regional BD team we’re building from scratch. Your income grows directly with the volume your partners bring in, and the bonus is uncapped.

What you’ll do

Hunting: find the partners who matter

  • Map the partners with the biggest reach in MENA and LatAm: crypto (exchanges, wallets, media, communities), iGaming and gambling (operators, affiliate networks, streamers), brokers (forex, CFD, investment platforms), fintech and payments, large media and influencer agencies.
  • Work the field: attend crypto, iGaming, affiliate and fintech conferences across MENA and LatAm, book meetings in advance and close partnerships on site.
  • Use your own network and local reputation to get in front of decision-makers, not just whoever answers an email.

Closing: run the full cycle

  • Own every deal end to end: first contact, negotiation, agreeing terms, onboarding, launching traffic and the first sales.
  • Negotiate with founders and senior management, and show clearly what partnering with GoMining is worth to them and their audience.
  • When a partner says no, find out why and bring that back so we can sharpen the offer.

Growing: turn partners into volume

  • Grow the partners you’ve signed: higher volume, new formats, and special offers for their audiences.
  • Keep your pipeline up to date in the CRM, report weekly on the funnel, and file a short results report after every trip.
  • Share what you see in the MENA and LatAm markets (competitor offers, partner expectations, local payment specifics) with the team.

What success looks like

  • First month: you know the product and the partner offer inside out, your MENA/LatAm pipeline is mapped, and your conference and meeting calendar for the next quarter is set.
  • First 3 months: you’re running a steady rhythm of in-person meetings, your first partnerships are signed and live, and the first sales are coming in through your partners.
  • Ongoing: we measure you on new active partners per month, sales volume and revenue from those partners, and how well your meetings convert into signed deals.
  • 3+ years in business development, partnerships or affiliate management in crypto, iGaming, gambling, brokerage or fintech.
  • Your own network in MENA and/or LatAm (affiliates, networks, operators, media). This is the main requirement.
  • A track record of closing large partnership deals, with numbers you can walk us through.
  • Confidence negotiating with founders and senior management.
  • Readiness to travel a lot to conferences and meetings across MENA and LatAm.
  • A hunter mindset: proactive, fast-paced, driven by results and money.
  • Fluent English.

Would be a plus

  • A regional language: Arabic for MENA, Spanish or Portuguese for LatAm.
  • A personal reputation in the local crypto, affiliate or iGaming community.
  • A strong grasp of affiliate models (CPA, RevShare, hybrid) and traffic.
  • Experience with large affiliate networks and streamers.
  • Knowledge of payment specifics in MENA and LatAm markets.
  • Sales-driven pay: a fixed salary plus an uncapped bonus on the sales volume your partners bring in.
  • A travel and conference budget for field work across MENA and LatAm.
  • Fast decisions and direct access to the head of the direction.
  • Professional growth: support for courses, conferences, and English learning (up to 100% coverage).
  • Work-life fit: remote format with flexible hours across international teams.
  • Paid leave: up to 20 vacation days + 8 company holidays + 5 personal days per year.
  • Team culture: retreats in international locations (for example, company apartments in Cyprus).

What is Kalshi?

Kalshi has defined a new category: prediction markets. Kalshi allows people to trade on the outcome of any events and turn any question about the future into a financial asset. Kalshi fought for years and legalized prediction markets in the US for the first time in history, is currently the fastest growing financial market in America, and has thousands of markets across politics, economics, financials, weather, tech, AI, culture and more.

We believe prediction markets have the potential to be the largest financial market because they turn anything into a financial position.

  • Our vision: well… build the largest financial market on the planet.

  • Our mission: bring more truth to the world through the power of markets.

Our culture is simple: we hire really talented people, work really hard, and enjoy the climb. We are looking for ambitious and exceptional people to join our (relatively small) team to help us build the next generation of financial markets.


Role Roadmap

Local businesses are closely tied to the communities and economies around them. A restaurant may depend on visitors coming to town for a sporting event. A transport company may be sensitive to changes in fuel prices. Weather, policy decisions, and shifts in the economy can affect an owner’s revenue, costs, and ability to plan.

We’re looking for someone curious, analytical, and thoughtful about relationships to help businesses explore how Kalshi can help offset some of these risks. You’ll spend time with business owners, learn how their businesses work, and find creative opportunities to make hedging understandable and useful.

This role combines an interest in current events and local economies with a strong understanding of financial risk. It calls for someone who listens closely, earns trust over time, and follows through with practical help. You’ll help shape how Kalshi works with businesses, starting with what matters to the people running them.

 

What You'll Do

  • Build relationships with business owners and community organizations to understand local economies and the risks businesses face

  • Find creative hedging opportunities by connecting current events, weather, policy, and economic changes to business needs

  • Educate owners about using Kalshi to offset risk, with clear explanations of costs, benefits, and limitations

  • Help businesses use relevant markets and work with the Markets team to develop new ones where needed

  • Support onboarding, follow through with owners, and bring their feedback back to Kalshi

     

Backgrounds We Value

Founder experience and a background in finance or consulting are strongly preferred. Relevant experience could include:

  • Founding or helping build a company, with firsthand experience of the decisions and uncertainties business owners face.

  • Investment banking internship at a bulge-bracket or elite-boutique firm, or strategy consulting at McKinsey, Bain, BCG, or a similarly rigorous firm.

  • Trading, derivatives, commodities, treasury, corporate risk management, or client-facing financial work, particularly helping businesses understand and manage their exposures.

  • Underwriting bespoke insurance, with experience assessing unusual or complex risks, pricing coverage, and structuring tailored policies around a client’s specific exposures.

  • Building long-term business or community partnerships, developing practical financial education, or helping people use a new financial product.

 

NYC Pay Transparency Disclosure

Base Salary Range: $100,000-105,000 plus equity for 0-1 years of experience. Negotiable based on tenure


This range reflects current market data for this role. Kalshi has minimal hierarchy and broad variance in experience levels within each title; if your compensation expectations exceed this range, we encourage you to reach out — we’re always happy to discuss.

 

Our Culture

Meritocracy is at our core, and we value people who take ownership and figure (usually hard) things out. We dream big. We love our craft deeply and are proud of what we put out in the world. We are committed to our vision of building something big… but also useful: a product that brings more truth through the power of markets.

Kalshians are Kalshi’s most important asset: we pick Kalshians carefully, so we trust them fully on day 1.

Commitment to Equal Opportunity

Kalshi is committed to creating a culture of inclusion and belonging, and we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We believe it is our collective responsibility to uphold these values and encourage candidates from all backgrounds to join us in our mission. All qualified applicants will be treated with respect and receive equal consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, uniform service, veteran status, age, or any other protected characteristic per federal, state, or local law. If you are passionate about what you do and want to use your talents to support our mission and values, we’d love to hear from you.

About Helius

Helius is building the core infrastructure for Solana - empowering developers to create the next generation of crypto-powered applications. Our mission is to accelerate the development of internet capital markets by making it easier, faster, and more intuitive to build on-chain.

Thousands of teams - from early-stage startups to industry leaders like Coinbase, Phantom, and Jupiter - rely on Helius APIs, webhooks, and indexing tools to power their products. Backed by Haun Ventures, Founders Fund, and Foundation Capital, we’re a small, senior team obsessed with performance, simplicity, and scalability in decentralized systems.

Read our Helius Manifesto to see how we work and what we value.


About the Role

We’re hiring our first Head of Security. You’ll own security across Helius and lead it hands-on: doing the work yourself across our engineering platform while building toward a team. You’ll report to our COO and Head of Engineering, and our leadership team will depend on you to understand, manage, and make clear calls on risk.

Your priorities are to establish a strong security posture across our engineering platform and to own incident response. You’ll have real authority and a clear mandate to protect a company operating critical infrastructure at scale.

What You'll Do

  • Lead security at Helius, setting direction and owning execution across infrastructure, cloud, and production systems

  • Own incident response end to end: detection, response, runbooks, on-call readiness, and regular tabletop exercises

  • Establish a strong security posture across our engineering platform, including identity and access management, secrets and key management, network segmentation, logging, monitoring, and detection

  • Review and manage third-party and supply-chain risk

  • Partner with engineering to embed security into how we build and ship, without becoming a bottleneck

  • Lead our compliance roadmap and respond to customer security reviews

  • Hire, develop, and grow the security team as we scale

  • Own the security strategy and roadmap, and maintain our threat model and risk register, prioritizing against real risk

  • Communicate clearly about risk with executives, engineers, and customers

What We're Looking For

  • 8+ years in security, including experience securing high-availability, internet-facing infrastructure at scale

  • Strong engineering skills: you read and write code and can dig into systems yourself

  • Deep expertise in cloud security, bare metal and production environments

  • Hands-on experience with detection and response, and you’ve led through a real security incident

  • Experience building a security program or significantly scaling a security function

  • Experience securing developer products, APIs, or platforms

  • Strong grasp of secrets and key management

  • Comfortable moving fast, iterating, and making good decisions under pressure

  • Pragmatic and high-ownership: you do the work and don’t wait for a large team or established tooling

  • Clear communicator who can partner with engineers and say no without being a blocker

  • Comfortable working in a fully remote, async-friendly team


Nice to Have

  • Experience leading a SOC 2 or similar audit

  • Prior security leadership at a high-growth startup

Why Helius?

  • High-impact work: Your code will power applications used by millions across the Solana ecosystem, including Coinbase, Jupiter, and Phantom.

  • Serious engineering: Build fast, reliable systems across distributed infra and high-throughput backends.

  • Ownership & growth: Lead critical initiatives, influence architecture and product direction, and take on more responsibility as the company scales.

  • Remote-first flexibility: Work where you’re most effective with a flexible, fully distributed team.

  • Competitive comp & perks: Market-leading salary, meaningful equity, generous vacation, wellness budgets, and support for learning and travel.

  • Mission-driven team: Join ambitious builders who move fast, take ownership, and are shaping the future of decentralized apps.

Growth GTM Engineering sits at the intersection of marketing strategy, revenue generation, data, and automation, turning market intelligence and buyer insight into repeatable growth opportunities for Chainalysis.

Chainalysis is seeking a Growth GTM Engineer to build and scale the workflows, systems, and outbound strategies that help our Sales teams engage the right customers at the right time. This is not a traditional demand generation or marketing operations role. Growth GTM Engineers are hands on builders who own the full lifecycle of a growth play, from identifying an opportunity and developing a hypothesis through workflow creation, experimentation, and measurable commercial impact.

The role combines growth marketing, account based strategy, data enrichment, AI, and sales enablement. You will work directly with Sales to identify promising markets, uncover buying signals, map buying committees, and turn these insights into targeted outbound plays. Using Clay, AI, and connected data workflows, you will give sellers the context and tools they need to engage prospects more effectively.


Success requires strong marketing judgement, technical curiosity, hands on workflow building experience, and the ability to connect automation to real commercial outcomes.


In this role, you’ll:

  • Identify promising market segments, buying situations, and account level triggers in partnership with Sales.
  • Develop targeted outbound plays, defining the audience, buyer problem, messaging, offer, seller action, and success criteria.
  • Build, own, and optimise Clay tables and research workflows, connecting enrichment, signal detection, account research, and contact discovery.
  • Use AI to interpret market signals, classify accounts, and generate relevant research and messaging inputs.
  • Map key accounts and buying committees, providing sellers with clear, evidence based insights and recommended actions.
  • Work directly with Sales teams to test outbound plays, gather feedback, measure performance, and determine what to scale or refine.
  • Establish quality controls and source references to ensure research and AI generated outputs are accurate and trustworthy.
  • Turn successful experiments into reusable workflows, signals, audience logic, and play templates.

Build a Safer World.

TRM Labs provides AI-powered intelligence solutions that help public and private sector agencies investigate and disrupt crime. TRM's platforms enable investigators to trace illicit activity, build cases, and construct operating pictures of threat networks. Leading agencies and businesses worldwide rely on TRM to make the world safer and more secure.

TRM helps governments and law enforcement trace and stop illicit finance. This role brings that mission to investigators, financial intelligence units, tax and customs agencies, and regulators across Italy and Southern Europe. You will own TRM’s public sector business in a territory where we are building coverage, setting account strategy and closing six- and seven-figure deals through direct sales and partners. What makes this seat unusual is a large greenfield territory plus the freedom to shape your own go-to-market, procurement approach and partner network with AI-assisted research.

The impact you will have:

  • Map every priority agency in Italy and Southern Europe, using AI tools to identify budget holders, investigators, procurement offices and upcoming tenders so your first outreach reaches the right people in week one.

  • Win six- and seven-figure deals by turning investigative pain points into a clear business case, using AI-assisted segmentation and local-language messaging, and measure what converts.

  • Build a 3x qualified pipeline each quarter through targeted outreach, agency training days and events, and measure what converts.

  • Decide how TRM reaches each agency, choosing between direct selling and approved resellers or integrators, and back each choice with AI-assisted analysis of procurement routes.

  • Grow live customers through renewals, upsells, and new use cases, using AI summaries of usage and call notes to spot expansion signals early.

  • Bring customer and regulatory insight back to Product, Policy and Law Enforcement Relations so the next release matches how agencies in your region actually work.

What we’re looking for:

  • 6+ years selling SaaS, data intelligence or investigative solutions to government, law enforcement or regulators in Italy or Southern Europe,

  • A record of closing six- and seven-figure deals and meeting quota, including experience running tenders, RFx responses or framework purchases.

  • Working knowledge of Italian and EU public procurement, AML and digital asset regulation, and how investigators, budget holders and procurement teams buy.

  • Hands-on use of AI for prospecting, account planning, and tender and call preparation, with clear examples of time or revenue gained.

  • Experience building pipeline from scratch in a new territory, including working with resellers or integrators

  • Credible, clear communication with senior officials and investigators, in person and virtually.

  • Fluent Italian and English; Spanish, Portuguese or Greek is a strong plus.

  • Based in Italy (Rome or Milan preferred), willingness to travel regularly across the region.

About the Team:

  • TRM’s EMEA Sales team gives each Account Director full ownership of a territory and the room to choose how to win it.

  • The team collaborates closely and supports one another through shared pipeline insight, deal reviews, and open sharing of what works.

  • The work is hard in a useful way: public buyers, several countries, long procurement cycles, and a product category that is new to many agencies.

  • You will work with Law Enforcement Relations, Solutions Architecture, Legal and Deal Desk, Partnerships, Product, and Policy, who move quickly to back your deals.

Learn about TRM Speed in this position:

  • Within your first 30 days, you rank every target agency in your territory and start outreach to the top tier, so pipeline grows before onboarding ends.

  • When an agency shares a tender late on a Friday and gives you three days to respond, you pull together Solutions, Legal and your partner to submit a strong, detailed response on time.

  • Within 90 days, you build qualified pipeline worth at least 3x your quota, backed by an account plan and a buying route for every Tier 1 agency.

Team Operating Rhythms:

  • Distributed, not distant: the team works across UK and CET time zones, with occasional US calls on complex deals.

  • Company-wide all-hands and founder Q&A sessions keep everyone connected to the mission.

Required online and collaboration hours:

  • Schedule: Core hours on CET, with overlap to UK hours and occasional US calls. HM to confirm.

Application Instructions

If you’re interested in joining TRM, we encourage you to apply directly. Every application is reviewed by our Talent team.

Before applying, review the job description carefully and highlight the experience and impact that best demonstrate the required qualifications. Please also provide thoughtful and accurate answers to the application questions, as these will be used to evaluate your skills and qualifications for the role.

If you send your resume directly to someone at TRM, we can’t guarantee it will reach the appropriate hiring team. Applying directly is the best way to ensure your application will be considered.

Interviewing with TRM

Our process is designed to understand how you think, solve problems, and deliver impact, while allowing you to evaluate TRM. Most interview processes include a case study, an AI skills assessment, and a Leadership Principles interview.

  • Recruiter Intro: Qualifications, motivations, and alignment with the role.

  • Hiring Manager: Deep dive into your relevant experience, skills, and impact.

  • First Round: 1–2 interviews focused on the skills most critical to the role.

  • Final Round: Hands-on case study. This is usually a panel-style session where we go deeper into your craft, problem-solving, and alignment with TRM.

  • References: Former colleagues who can provide insight into your work and impact.

  • Offer: Congrats! Your recruiter will present the offer and compensation details.

  • Welcome to TRM: We're excited to build a safer world with you!

Your recruiter will share your specific interview plan and preparation guidance along the way.

AI Fluency at TRM

AI fluency is a baseline expectation at TRM.

We believe AI meaningfully changes how top performers operate. We expect every team member to use AI to accelerate and reimagine their craft, not just automate surface tasks.

At TRM, AI fluency means you are among the top 10 percent of operators in your function in how you apply AI to:

  • Accelerate repeatable workflows

  • Structure and solve problems

  • Improve output quality

  • Increase speed and leverage

You will be evaluated on applied AI fluency during the interview process.

Life at TRM

We are building a safer world. That promise shows up in how we work every day.

TRM moves FAST. We are a high-velocity, high-ownership team that expects clarity, follow-through, and impact. People who thrive here are energized by hard problems, experimentation, and continuous feedback. If something takes months elsewhere, it will ship here in days.

Our work sits at the intersection of AI, national security, and fighting crime. The problems are complex, the stakes are real, and the environment evolves quickly. The pace and intensity of the work reflect the importance of the mission. As a result, the way we operate requires a high level of ownership, adaptability, collaboration, and creative problem-solving.

At TRM, you should expect:

  • Priorities and targets to change quickly

  • Operating with a high degree of ambiguity

  • A high level of personal ownership and accountability

  • Close collaboration across teams and functions

  • Frequent, high-touch communication

  • Creative problem-solving and out-of-the-box thinking

  • A pace that rewards urgency, adaptability, and outcomes

This environment is energizing for people who enjoy building, solving hard problems, and making progress in situations that are not always fully defined. It also requires thriving in ambiguity, adjusting course as new information emerges, and maintaining focus and positivity in a fast-moving and intense environment.

We also recognize that this style of operating is not for everyone. If you are primarily optimizing for predictability or a consistently balanced workload, we encourage you to use the interview process to pressure-test whether this environment is truly the right fit. We want teammates who thrive here, not just survive here.

If you are excited by meaningful problems, motivated by ambitious goals, and energized by working alongside mission-driven colleagues, there is a good chance you will find TRM to be an exceptional place to grow and contribute.

Leadership Principles

We hire and grow against three leadership principles. They’re the standards for how we operate, treat each other, and make decisions.

  • Impact-Oriented Trailblazer: We put customers first and move with speed, focus, and adaptability. We treat every plan like an experiment – test, ship, measure, and iterate quickly.

  • Master Craftsperson: We care deeply about our craft. We balance speed with high standards, own outcomes end‑to‑end, and invest in getting better everyday.

  • Inspiring Colleague: We add clarity and energy, not noise. We bring humility, candor, and a one‑team mindset — giving and receiving feedback to make the team stronger.

Join our Mission

At TRM, we care deeply about our craft. We are looking for individuals who want their work to matter, who experiment with speed and rigor, and who take pride in building a safer world for billions of people. If you’re excited by TRM’s mission but don’t check every box, we encourage you to apply — we hire for slope, judgment, and the will to learn fast.

TRM is a Series C company with $220M in total funding, backed by Goldman Sachs, Bessemer, Y Combinator, Thoma Bravo, and others. Headquartered in San Francisco, TRM operates as a distributed-first company with hubs in Los Angeles, San Francisco, New York, Washington D.C., London, and Singapore.

Privacy Policy and Additional Information

By submitting your application, you agree to allow TRM Labs to process your personal information in accordance with our Privacy Policy.

We collect the information you provide (such as your resume, work history, and contact details) solely for the purpose of evaluating your candidacy for current and future roles at TRM.

Because our hiring cycles for certain positions may span 24 to 36 months, we retain your personal information for up to 36 months from the date of your application. After that period, your data is deleted unless a different retention period is required or permitted by law.

If you are located in the European Economic Area, the United Kingdom, or another jurisdiction with applicable data protection laws, you have the right to access, correct, or request deletion of your personal data at any time before that period ends. To exercise any of these rights, contact us at privacy@trmlabs.com.

To notify TRM Labs that you believe this job posting is non-compliant, please submit a report through this form. No response will be provided to inquiries unrelated to job posting compliance.

The use of AI tools of any kind (including but not limited to notetakers, interview assistants, and real-time coaching tools such as Otter.ai, Fireflies, Fathom, Cluey, or similar) during TRM interviews is not permitted without prior approval from TRM. TRM uses its own internal tools for note-taking to ensure a consistent and confidential experience for all candidates.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities, and requests can be made via this form.

Recruitment agencies

TRM Labs does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to TRM employees. TRM Labs is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes and will not pay fees to any third-party agency or company without a signed agreement.
